title: TEACHING ON BAPTISM: THREE BAPTISMS FOR TRUE BELIEVERS

blocks.text: Introduction: This very important study will look into three types of baptisms every believer must undergo. These are: The Baptism into Christ and His body The Baptism in Water or Water baptism The Holy Spirit Baptism

cards.heading: 1. B aptism Into Christ and His Body

blocks.text: What does it mean to be baptized into Christ? Discuss: Being Baptized into Christ church by one spirit, {{1co 12:13|I Cor. 12:13}} By putting on Christ {{gl 3:27|Gal. 3:27}}, By having one faith in Christ Eph: 4:5; By being partakers of his body {{1co 10:17|I Cor. 10:17}}.

Our Lord Jesus Christ was baptized. {{mt 3:13,mt 3:14,mt 3:15,mt 3:16,mt 3:17|Mt. 3:13-17}} The first set of converts after the Pentecost was baptized. {{act 2:41|Acts 2:41}}, {{act 8:12,act 8:38|Acts 8:12, 38}} As people gave their life to Christ they were immediately baptized. {{act 16:33|Acts 16:33}}; {{act 18:8|Acts 18:8}} All of the above gave us the scriptural evidence of water baptism

Why water baptism must be by immersion: The word baptism in Greek is "Baptizo" which means to submerge or immerse. It expressed the reality of burial with Christ ({{rm 6:4|Rom. 6:4}}). Bible references indicate it being carried out by and in the river. ({{mt 3:6,mt 3:13|Mt. 3:6, 13}})

The importance and or significance of water baptism: It is an outward symbol of an inward reality - genuine conversion. It is a symbol of identification with the death, burial and resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ. ({{rm 6:3,rm 6:4,rm 6:5,rm 6:6|Rom. 6:3-6}}) It is an open declaration of separation from the world. It is to follow the example of the Lord Jesus Christ in fulfilling all righteousness. Mat. 3: 3-15; {{1pe 2:21|I Pet. 2: 21}}; {{jo 13:5|John 13:5}}

In whose name should water baptism be carried out? We are to be baptized in the name of God the Father, God the Son and God the Holy Spirit. The Minister of God (The Pastor) is the agent of this type of Baptism. {{mt 28:19|Matt. 28:19}}.

How appropriate or scriptural is infant baptism? Discuss. ({{act 8:12|Acts 8: 12}}) The scripture demands repentance toward God and faith towards Christ ({{act 20:21|Acts 20: 21}}) as basic conditions for Water Baptism and no child can do this until he or she is matured enough to understand sin and what to do to be saved. Water baptism is a command Water baptism is a command it is not optional, so long as a believer remains alive after conversion. {{mk 16:16|Mark 16:16}}

The regenerating work of the Holy Spirit is different from His work of baptism. In regeneration, there is impartation of the divine life or nature of God ({{1pe 1:4|I Pet. 1:4}}), but in baptism with the Holy Spirit there is impartation of divine Power for effective Christian service. Lk.24:49; {{act 1:4,act 1:5,act 1:8|Acts 1:4-5, 8}}; 3:1

What is the immediate outward sign of the Holy Spirit Baptism? {{act 2:4|Acts 2:4}}; {{act 8:17|Acts 8:17}}; {{act 10:44,act 10:45,act 10:46|Acts 10:44-46}}; {{act 19:6,act 19:7|Acts 19:6-7}} It gives power for effective and result oriented Christian service. {{act 1:8|Acts 1:8}}; 2:41 It imparts boldness for service. {{act 2:1,act 2:2,act 2:3,act 2:4,act 2:5,act 2:6,act 2:7,act 2:8,act 2:9,act 2:10,act 2:11,act 2:12,act 2:13,act 2:14|Acts 2: 1-14}}; {{act 4:31|Acts 4:31}}; {{prv 28:1|Prov. 28:1}} At regeneration, we have Holy Spirit as "resident" in the believer but at the Holy Spirit baptism, we have Him as the "President".

Who should receive this baptism and when? Discuss {{mk 16:17|Mark 16:17}}; {{act 10:44|Acts 10:44}}; {{lk 11:9,lk 11:10,lk 11:11,lk 11:12,lk 11:13|Lk. 11:9- 13}}; {{act 5:32|Acts 5:32}} every obedient child of God. Who is the agent of baptism in this case? {{lk 3:16|Luke 3:16}}. The Lord Jesus Christ is the agent of Holy spirit baptism.
